prompts.prompt: Wide shot of Kulturhuset Stadsteatern's Galleri 5 in Stockholm, visitors moving through a softly lit contemporary exhibition of textile sculptures, hanging woven forms, and painted panels. Overhead spotlights cast warm pools on the floor, natural daylight filtering from tall windows.

Medium photograph of a single museum-goer standing close to a large mixed-media painting in a white-cube gallery, observing it from a slight angle. Soft directional gallery lighting picks out the textured brushwork, while other framed works recede along the wall behind.

Environmental view inside the Nationalmuseum in Stockholm, high-ceilinged hall with natural light from tall windows, visitors walking between canvases of Nordic modernist paintings. Pale marble floors, muted parquet, and quiet crowd in a reverent atmosphere.

Close detail shot of a dark-toned oil painting's surface, showing a fragmented figurative composition with a glowing spatial light installation bleeding into the background. A visitor's shoulder and clasped hands appear softly out of focus at the frame's edge.
